mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp in 3 months does not correlate with improved corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 5% in 2 months does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the easing signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with positive equity returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% in 2 months does not correlate with negative equity returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the past month signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase > 2% in 1 month does not correlate with increased consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with positive equity returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% over the past quarter, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2% in 1 quarter
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition of high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not correlate with negative equity returns.
